title: Yeast biopanning for detecting antibody binding to site-specific phosphorylations in tau
authors: Monika Arbaciauskaite; Azady Pirhanov; Yu Lei; Yong Ku Cho
one_liner_zh: 该文利用酵母生物淘选检测磷酸化tau抗体的结合，属于抗体-肽段互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The detection of phosphorylated tau (p-tau) levels in clinical samples is of extreme importance for the detection of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) as well as other neurodegenerative diseases. Recent reports show that detecting low levels of p-tau in plasma can be used as a reliable biomarker for detecting AD prior to the onset of memory loss. The ability to detect such low levels of p-tau is dependent on antibodies specific to the post translationally modified protein. However, the need for reliable phospho-site specific antibodies persists due to a lack of approaches for identifying monoclonal antibodies and characterizing non-specific binding. Here, we report a novel approach using the principles of yeast biopanning to create a robust platform that uses synthetic peptides as target antigens. Using peptides as antigens enables screening antibodies against defined post-translational modification sites, particularly for targeting intrinsically disordered proteins such as the human tau protein. To readily assess yeast binding and distinguish non-specific binding, we developed bi-directional expression vectors that allow antibody fragment surface display and intracellular fluorescent protein expression. We show that our platform can specifically and robustly detect a specific site within the p-tau target peptide when compared against non-phosphorylated controls. By improving biopanning parameters, we enabled phospho-specific capture of yeast cells displaying single-chain variable region fragments (scFvs) against p-tau with a wide range of affinities (K D = 0.2 to 60 nM). These results demonstrate that yeast biopanning can robustly capture yeast cells based on phospho-site specific antibody binding, opening doors for facile identification of high-quality monoclonal antibodies.
abstract_zh: 临床样本中磷酸化tau（p-tau）水平的检测对于阿尔茨海默病（AD）及其他神经退行性疾病的检测极为重要。近期报告显示，检测血浆中低水平的p-tau可作为AD在记忆丧失发生前可靠检测的生物标志物。检测如此低水平p-tau的能力依赖于针对翻译后修饰蛋白的特异性抗体。然而，由于缺乏识别单克隆抗体和表征非特异性结合的方法，对可靠磷酸化位点特异性抗体的需求仍然存在。在此，我们报告了一种新方法，利用酵母生物淘选原理构建了一个以合成肽作为靶抗原的稳健平台。使用肽作为抗原能够针对明确的翻译后修饰位点筛选抗体，特别适用于靶向如人tau蛋白等内在无序蛋白。为便于评估酵母结合并区分非特异性结合，我们开发了双向表达载体，可实现抗体片段表面展示和细胞内荧光蛋白表达。我们证明，与未磷酸化对照相比，我们的平台能够特异且稳健地检测p-tau靶肽内的特定位点。通过改进生物淘选参数，我们实现了对展示针对p-tau的单链可变区片段（scFvs）的酵母细胞进行磷酸化特异性捕获，其亲和力范围广泛（K D = 0.2至60 nM）。这些结果表明，酵母生物淘选能够基于磷酸化位点特异性抗体结合稳健地捕获酵母细胞，为简便识别高质量单克隆抗体打开了大门。
